title: Calibrated target-direction inference from complete memory-period functional-ultrasound response fields
disposition_reason: A real grouped direction scorer, complete-field preparation algorithm and identical nine-map packet constructor are delivered. They consume a prospective normalized input ABI; native acquisition intervals, geometry, Run99 lineage and actual image transport remain unqualified, so generated full-roster tests are not a usable authentic direction benchmark.

scientific_target.question: From the same eight calibrated full-field fUS response maps and one query map, can direct visual interpretation, a fixed programme or numerical investigation infer the query target direction?
scientific_target.known_answer: One of eight target directions 0,45,…315 degrees, derived privately from source behavior.targetPos with verified x-right/y-up convention.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Behavioral target coordinates, not neural-decoder predictions; source label/clock joins must be authenticated.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete memory-period response map for a noncalibration trial within held session/run.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Two macaques, with sessions/runs and trials nested; 49 records and 20,622 declared slots do not create 49 or 20,622 animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline calibrated target-direction information in a lossy vascular response image; cue direction, planned saccade and rewarded direction coincide.
exclusions: Causal separation of visual memory and motor planning.
Real-time electrical neural decoding or exact source-float access.
Animal-population generalization from two macaques or protected unknown-data performance.
